en.headline: Released opencode-skill-management 0.1.0 with 5 commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-20, activity was concentrated in the `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` repository with **5 own commits**, all related to the 0.1.0 release and documentation. The commits include: recording the 0.1.0 release result (trusted publishing verified as Valid with provenance); adding git spec runtime load test notes confirming the preferred distribution channel works end-to-end; adding release lifecycle acceptance covering 0.1.0 runtime update/remove flows and host CLI quirks; adding v5 real-host round-trip regression evidence (disable → permission.rejected → enable → byte-by-byte restore); and a chore commit completing the 0.1.0 release (rc.1 published by CI with provenance). The `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` repo had 4 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. No PRs, issues, reviews, releases, or discussion activity occurred, and no section was truncated.

zh.headline: 发布 opencode-skill-management 0.1.0，共 5 次提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-20 当天活动集中在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 仓库，共有 **5 次本人提交**，均与 0.1.0 版本发布及文档补充有关。提交内容包括：回写 0.1.0 发布结果（trusted publishing 验证为 Valid，附 provenance）；补充 git spec 运行时加载实测记录，确认首选分发通道闭环；补充发布生命周期验收，涵盖 0.1.0 运行时 update/remove 流程及宿主 CLI 问题；补充 v5 真实宿主的往返回归证据（disable → permission.rejected → enable → 逐字节还原）；以及一次 chore 提交完成 0.1.0 发布（rc.1 由 CI 发布并带 provenance）。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库另有 4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。当天无 PR、issue、review、release 或讨论活动，各列表均未触发截断。
